title: Support agent skill
summary: Adds the /grillo-support skill: it answers questions about the project and its agents and, after the member presses Send, writes a relay request that reuses the agent chat relay, marked 'from Support, for <member>'; the reader refuses malformed requests, self-written marks and messages ending in a screen control line.
lessons_learned: A skill whose output is relayed into another agent's chat must refuse text whose last line is a screen control line (README protocol table), or the relay can press a button such as Done in the target agent

deferred.what: Issue #96 (support agent tab screen) does not mention the grillo-relay request contract, so it could ship without reading the block, handing it to agent-chat:relay and typing back 'relayed:' / 'not relayed:'; until then nothing is ever relayed
deferred.why: The tab is out of this issue's scope
